# v1.1.0-dev.115: The collapsed-windows modal

Pre-release off the `dev` branch. Builds on `v1.1.0-dev.114`.

## A proper modal for docked windows

The small flyout that listed collapsed windows is a modal now: a header,
a row for every docked window (clicking a visible row collapses it,
clicking a collapsed one restores it), and a footer with **Collapse all**
and **Restore all**. Each footer button greys itself out at its end of the
range: Collapse all when everything is already collapsed, Restore all when
everything is visible. The button on the virtual window's title bar opens
it whenever anything is docked, not only after something collapses.

## Collapsed panes look empty

A collapsed window's pane now draws nothing at all, as if nothing were
docked there. The way back is the modal, and the "collapsed" label the pane
used to draw read as a second, lesser affordance beside it.

## Install

Auto-updates from dev.53 and later. Otherwise unzip and run.
